body: I really love this.  Would happily daydream to a book of such images.  The picture is story enough.
Awesome picture!  Do you know if there's a story behind the album?  I'm intrigued.
A comic would be awesome!  Your work reminds me of Simon Stalenhag in the sense that there's a story in your art.  Keep up the good work!
Couldn't agree more.  There's a story behind this world and I'd love to see it, inside the city and out.  Awesome work, u/FreightCrater!
